blocks.content: Here's how you can space the links apart:

items: display: flex arranges the links in a horizontal row.
gap: 24px creates space between each link.
color: white matches the header color.
font-size: 16px and letter-spacing: 1px  increases the font size and spacing between each letter, improving readability.

blocks.content: Since you have used flexbox for the most part, the layout should be responsive. Check how the website looks on a mobile device by resizing the output browser.
